correctness.rationale: Smooth coordinate tangency implies inverse dual coefficients b_ii=0; direct symmetric 4x4 determinant expansion gives delta, and tr B=0 forces indefinite form, so sign(det B)>0 iff exactly two negative eigenvalues in dimension four. Inversion preserves inertia. Signature (2,2) supplies a real Segre P1×P1 model with O(1,1) hyperplane sections; each tangent coordinate section is a rank-one *real* bilinear form, hence factors ℓ_i(s)m_i(t) over R and the four sections span H0(O(1,1)). These factors give two actual embedded real projective lines whose coordinatewise product is all of W, with no base points. Conversely a real line factor yields a real projective line in W after multiplying by a generic real point with all coordinates nonzero, impossible for a real quadric of Witt index 1. Factorization pairs are unique up to reciprocal coordinate scalars for a chosen ruling order, yielding two free dimension-three torus orbits exchanged by swapping factors. Real signatures give RP1×RP1≅T² versus projective one-sheet cone S². Independent exact six-variable symbolic determinant identity and explicit split/nonsplit witnesses support the general algebraic proof.
